title: Tout a par moy I (Agricola)
desc: Alexander Agricola, Tout a par moy I. 4 voices (Superius, Tenor, Contratenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Agr3051); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
